differences.openwhisper: SettingsDialog(staged=True) builds the window in generator steps of about 100 ms that the controller runs 2500 ms after start, one per 60 ms, retrying each second while recording or in a meeting.
differences.fiorivoce: The window is built when first opened and each page is built on its first visit; there is no idle builder.
differences.reason: Lazy pages already keep the first opening fast, and an idle builder adds a second construction path for no gain in the C++ app.
differences.source: docs/port/ARCHITECTURE.md 8.5 ('The Settings window's staged idle build is dropped; pages stay lazily built on first visit') and docs/port/packages/M2.md 'Changes to the cut' item 6
